title: Sentiment analysis of multilingual and code-switched stress expressions among Nigerian university students
description: Inference and analysis code for a paired evaluation of sentiment models on original and English-interpreted stress expressions from Nigerian university students. The questionnaire texts are not included; they are available on request under the conditions stated in the article.
